title: nbn 500/50 $69/M for 6 Months, $10/M SubHub Streaming Credit, 34,000 Flybuys Points After 3 Months (New Customers) @ Optus
body:
Deal: nbn 500/50 $69/M for 6 Months, $10/M SubHub Streaming Credit, 34,000 Flybuys Points After 3 Months (New Customers) @ Optus

[VladImpaler] Can't see anything in T&Cs about whether future activation date qualifies for the points.
[bargain_finder] There is no future NBN activation with Optus, activates on signup
[mmrazz] Has that changed? I had no problems setting up activation 2 weeks in the future when I signed up in June (signed up June 30, activated July 14).
[parker2004au] Looks like you get 4G backup which is getting harder and harder to find these days, I want to change from iinet, its only come in handy like twice in 2 years but still nice to have.
[atw] If I go away and take the modem with the 4G connection with me, can I use it temoporarily for internet with just the 4G backup?
[jimojr] When I was with Telstra, I tried unplugging the NBN cable and the 4G backup kicked in and worked. So I think if I take the modem somewhere else, the 4G backup should work there too, but I am not 100% sure.
[PainToad] How did you come to the conclusion it's Optus's fault you live in an area without NBN. You probably have Opticomm. Distance from the CBD means nothing. Lots of units in CBDs won't have NBN.
[Make it so] How is Optus as ISP? Do they support IPv6?
[b0nd] Just disconnected last week from Optus 😂 not sure if I’m eligible
[Schrodinger] Same boat. Wonder what counts as a new customer. Used the Finder deal too last time.
[JumpingUnicorns] This seems like a good deal. 10k Flybuys equates to $50? So $170 total, then the $10 a month for subhub
[mclachat] If I am with Optus (from the finder deal) and move to this in my partners name would we get the points? Given it is the same address
[Make it so] Wouldn't that constitute a disconnection rather than a churn? And incur higher costs?
[Phantomsurfr] I did this promo in late july. Just got my $170 points in past week (~2 1/2 months). They do credit check on you at sign up. No IPv6. Didn't bother with subhub credit as I go my own way. Standard ISP experience but I was only in it for the churn and points.
[Make it so] Were they okay? Any congestion? Normally there isn't much on NBN, but I've had providers where the connection wasn't always stable (Superloop went that way towards the end).
[Phantomsurfr] I'm averaging 3tb downloads a month. Latency is higher than ABB I was previously with. Haven't really noticed congestion issues. Coming up 3 months I've been ok with it all, might see out the 6 months unless a better option comes my way. For the $170 I'm ok with the slightly less than product to ABB.
[Make it so] How bad is your latency? I'm not into gaming, but in WA we can get very high latencies if ISP's don't have a local PoI.
[Phantomsurfr] @Make it so: 83ms in bunvegas. ABB I was 40-50ms
[KingOfHearts] I am an existing Optus mobile customer (NBN with a different provider). Do I still qualify for this?
[vpn14] I think you will qualify.
I received flybuys points for NBN few months back when I had an existing Optus mobile connection.
[bargain_finder] Finder is offering $250 for signup
https://www.finder.com.au/broadband-plans/optus-nbn-rewards
[m13] If you go with finder, do you forgo the Flybuys points and the subs dollars?
[AdModnar] the subs thing stays, but can't stack the flybuys and the finder incentive
[The Hobo] Works out better in my opinion, rather have the gift card.
[Make it so] Interesting - looking at review score, Optus isn't getting a lot of love on Finder.
My past self would warn me that unreliable internet isn't worth the savings.
[The Hobo] I've made the jump. 3 months, let's see how we go. Can jump ship if it's no good :)
[Schrodinger] I moved out of Optus last months due to a cheaper deal. But the connection quality was pretty decent (in terms of speed/jitter).
Think they offered dynamic IP for free too.
The only negative was I'd planned the move moths earlier but I had to call Optus to cancel even after the new provider activated the service. On the plus side they have no notice period.
[Fastjam] Good financial deal, if you just watch/stream, pretty good, however if you play online games then this may be a dud deal, ping for my game jumped from 180/190 to over 250, up to 300 on a set of days…packets have a holiday in Singapore before heading to their final destination, please keep in mind (their tech support tried to argue it was speed then my equipment, showed them a tracert and they then said yeah can't help you)
[Kanjus] Finder doing $250 cash back on this.
https://www.finder.com.au/broadband-plans?utm_source=finder_…
[snuke] https://www.finder.com.au/finder-rewards/finder-optus-switch…
[Tight-AS5] Can I include this with the ShopBack offer for Optus NBN?
[lhou021] I just ordered via shopback, upsized cashback $250 is valid for 3 hours, will see what happens
[vpn14] Shopback offer is "Excluding BYO plans" for NBN.
[sicaboy] Yes they will call you to verify your documents
[excite] signed on Amaysim nbn 500/50 for $50 in the first 6 months, to be connected on Friday, can I cancel and go with this?
[killabob] Did the same…want to move to this but am i already locked in? Changeover is due 14th
[wine] You can online chat with Amaysim if you've scheduled NBN but not yet connected. They'll cancel the future dated scheduled connection and refund you the initial month you prepaid back to your payment method.
[Pseudomocha] I swapped for this deal last time around and I can't wait to move away, I'm getting woeful performance on Optus. So much stuff fails to load or loads really slowly.
Worked totally fine on other ISPs on the same connection.
[perfectlydark] warning against subhub - when you leave optus (and you will) they make it basically impossible to transfer streaming accounts out of subhub
[Silmo] The cashback from Shopback is interesting, tho I have already submitted for a plan with superloop which will start mid of this month. Can I cancel that and take this instead?
[Iwantthebestprice] Is Optus NBN a static IP or is it like mate where your set up with the CGNAT?
[Twix] Optus nbn: Dynamic IP, no CG-NAT and Static IP is not available.
[Betrayal90] So annoyed 🙃 went through finder, went through the process, checked out.
Wasn't until after i realised that i had to use a different email to sign up on optus vs what i started with on finder……
Went back into finder on the email i used to sign up with optus to trip the reward claim but im sure they'll refuse it.
How annoying.
Needed to jump as 6 months with amaysim was up but will be frustrated with myself if i miss the $250.
